episodes.synopsis: Yuuki Wakura wanders through a gate to an alternate dimension. He meets the Demon Defense Force including Chief Kyouka Uzen, who will reward him for his servitude.
episodes.title: Birth, Yuuki, Awakening

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki is recruited to work as a caretaker at the 7th Squadron’s dorm in Mato. Shushu catches him unaware and turns him into her boy toy. Suddenly, a giant Shuuki attacks!
episodes.title: Curiosity, Shushu, Undress

episodes.synopsis: With dozens of Shuuki detected, and a score to settle, Yuuki and the Demon Defense Force Squadron take an interdimensional trip!
episodes.title: Encounter, Kyouka,  Rampage

episodes.synopsis: The Demon Defense Force decides to take measures against the humanoid Shuuki. Meanwhile, Himari can adopt someone else’s ability, which she does to turn Yuuki “loyal” to her.
episodes.title: Whirlwind, Himari, Roar

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki hits Yachiho with a “Brand Break,” so she rewinds to before the beginning of the match. Later, Himari appreciates Yuuki; it’s time for his reward to begin!
episodes.title: Sisters, Yachiho, Ridicule

episodes.synopsis: Up next in Round 2: It's Shushu Suruga of the 7th Squadron versus Sahara Wakasa of the 6th Squadron! And after the match, Shushu has a surprise for Yuuki.
episodes.title: Blitz, Sahara, Twinkle

episodes.synopsis: Tenka confronts Rairen, then uses her ability to manipulate space. Later, Yuuuki tidies up and gets a face full of more than dirty laundry!
episodes.title: United Front, Tenka, Soar

episodes.synopsis: Tenka wants Yuuki as her new pet, but Kyouka declines her request. Nei explains her clairvoyant powers, the “promise.”
episodes.title: Promise, Nei, Remember

episodes.synopsis: A demon who looks like Yuuki’s sister appears and abducts him! Then after the dust settles, an enemy licks Yuuki down for... medical reasons.
episodes.title: Reunion, Coco, Lick

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki learns a less than peachy truth. Later, he receives a finger licking good reward.
episodes.title: War, Naon, Recite

episodes.synopsis: With Yuuki tied up and unable to fight, it’s up to the girls to harness the power of the peaches in a non-stop battle. Suddenly, those who control the demons appear...
episodes.title: Death Match, Aoba, Excite

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki finds a new reason to fight: to return Aoba to her original human form.
episodes.title: Homecoming, New, Resolve
